prompt: Which caption for the order book’s violet oval would meet Ellis’s request?
promptZh: 訂單簿上的紫色橢圓印痕，採用哪則說明最符合艾利斯的要求？

options.text: The impression was there before both cover repairs. Fenwick Stationery identifies the comparison image only.
options.zh: 這道印痕在兩次封面修補前就有。芬威克文具行的名稱只用於辨認對照照片。
options.whyZh: 把芬威克的名稱限用於辨認對照照片是對的，但完整印痕跨在原封面和後貼的修補條上，不可能在修補條裝上之前就形成。

options.text: The impression was made between the two cover repairs and can be credited to Fenwick Stationery.
options.zh: 這道印痕形成於兩次封面修補之間，可署名為芬威克文具行所做。
options.whyZh: 兩次修補間的推論符合位置證據，但圖檔只認定對照照片屬於芬威克。外形相同不能據以替本館的印痕署名。

options.text: The impression was made after the strip was put on but before the guard was added. Its maker is not established.
options.zh: 這道印痕形成於貼上修補條後、加裝護片前；製作者未能確認。
options.whyZh: 印痕完整跨過封面與修補條，表示是在貼條後形成；另有一段延伸到無痕護片下，表示早於加護片。芬威克與對照照片有關，不足以確認本館印痕的製作者。

options.text: The impression was made after both cover repairs. Its maker is not established, though a comparison image is available.
options.zh: 這道印痕形成於兩次封面修補之後；製作者未能確認，但有對照照片可參考。
options.whyZh: 製作者不明的部分正確，但印痕在沒有印痕的護片底下延續，不是加裝護片後才留下。

explanationZh: 印痕完整跨過封面與修補條，表示是在貼條後形成；另有一段延伸到無痕護片下，表示早於加護片。芬威克與對照照片有關，不足以確認本館印痕的製作者。
evidence: an intact impression crossing two surfaces was made after they were joined. / A matching outline alone is not enough. / A mark that continues underneath an unmarked guard flap was already there when that flap was put down. / Its outline crosses without a break from the original cover onto a strip added when the cover was repaired. / the violet line runs underneath an unmarked guard flap; it does not cross the flap's upper surface. / The order book’s own shop records name no such mark. / the guard was installed on a later visit to keep that area from rubbing. / We can use that name to identify the comparison, not as a credit under our book’s image.

vocabulary.note: 覆在書頁或封面局部的紙瓣，用來隔開表面、減少摩擦。
